lifecycleEvidence.decision: Admit Ethereum apyUSD and its currently configured receipt claim target. Official Sep 23 2026 update explicitly states apyUSD continues accruing, minting/redemption operate under existing terms and reserve attestations continue; TGE delay is not shutdown. Read official current documentation plus exact implementation, not stale legacy unlock prose.
lifecycleEvidence.metrics: Maintenance evidence only. No DAU or vault TVL asserted.

sourceSemantics.staking: Deployed ApyUSD inherits OZ ERC4626Upgradeable deposit/mint with virtual share accounting; overrides _deposit for caller/receiver deny-list. Pause hook covers share mint/burn/transfers. Price-control wrappers check previews before calling real deposit/mint.
sourceSemantics.exit: Current _withdraw requires receiver==owner, checks caller/receiver/owner against deny-list, pulls vested yield, burns shares for escrow assets+vault fee, routes fee, then calls configured UnlockReceipt.mint(receiver,uint208(assets)). Receipt NFT, not immediate apxUSD, is output. withdrawForReceipt/redeemForReceipt return transient-slot tokenId. Price limits cover escrow value, not final payout after receipt fee.
sourceSemantics.claim: Current UnlockReceipt.claim(tokenId,receiver) requires msg.sender==ownerOf(tokenId), nonzero receiver, maturity against CURRENT fee curve, not paused. Deletes position/burns NFT, transfers fee to wallet and net underlying to receiver. No cancel method in actual deployed ABI. Soulbound receipt approvals and transfers revert. Governance can change fee curve for existing receipts.
sourceSemantics.docConflict: Docs contain old 20-day one-request ERC7540 and UnlockToken flows alongside flexible NFT unlock prose. Exact current ApyUSD source explicitly marks unlockToken() deprecated. Old official address 0x93775E2dFa4e716c361A1f53F212c7AE031BF4e6 is NOT admitted.

selectedFunctions.label: Apyx Deposit apxUSD for apyUSD
warnings: Static deployment/source inventory only, not a fresh RPC/runtime/storage identity or successful-execution guarantee. Balances, allowances, pauses, canonical calldata, grants and independent execution checks remain mandatory; zero native value for all admitted calls.

Ethereum upgradeable apyUSD proxy 0x38EEb52F0771140d10c4E9A9a72349A329Fe8a6A, explorer-reported implementation 0xfD616567EcC1607F61073951A1E822F7315bB112; governance can change implementation, fees, deny-list and receipt wiring. No cross-chain or administrative calls admitted.
Underlying is apxUSD, not USDC. Deposits/mints consume apxUSD allowance and issue non-rebasing shares; use price-control variants when appropriate. Pause and deny-list restrictions apply.

Withdraw/redeem synchronously burn apyUSD but escrow apxUSD in a new soulbound UnlockReceipt NFT; they do not immediately pay liquid apxUSD. Receiver MUST equal share owner; price-control exit variants use msg.sender as owner, so receiver must equal caller. Receipt ID is returned by *ForReceipt or emitted via ReceiptIssued.

Both vault-side upfront unlocking fee and receipt-time variable fee may apply. PreviewRedeem/previewWithdraw describe receipt escrow, not final claim payout. Each receipt requires a separate owner-only claim after its current minimum duration; governance can immediately change the global fee curve for existing receipts.

Official docs contain stale single-request/20-day ERC7540 and legacy UnlockToken descriptions alongside newer NFT unlock documentation. The exact reviewed implementation uses receipt(), not deprecated unlockToken(); no legacy UnlockToken target is admitted. Jurisdiction restrictions still apply; permissionless contract access does not waive legal eligibility.

selectedFunctions.label: Apyx Claim matured apxUSD unlock receipt
warnings: Static deployment/source inventory only, not a fresh RPC/runtime/storage identity or successful-execution guarantee. Balances, allowances, pauses, canonical calldata, grants and independent execution checks remain mandatory; zero native value for all admitted calls.

Ethereum upgradeable apyUSD proxy 0x38EEb52F0771140d10c4E9A9a72349A329Fe8a6A, explorer-reported implementation 0xfD616567EcC1607F61073951A1E822F7315bB112; governance can change implementation, fees, deny-list and receipt wiring. No cross-chain or administrative calls admitted.
Underlying is apxUSD, not USDC. Deposits/mints consume apxUSD allowance and issue non-rebasing shares; use price-control variants when appropriate. Pause and deny-list restrictions apply.

Withdraw/redeem synchronously burn apyUSD but escrow apxUSD in a new soulbound UnlockReceipt NFT; they do not immediately pay liquid apxUSD. Receiver MUST equal share owner; price-control exit variants use msg.sender as owner, so receiver must equal caller. Receipt ID is returned by *ForReceipt or emitted via ReceiptIssued.

Both vault-side upfront unlocking fee and receipt-time variable fee may apply. PreviewRedeem/previewWithdraw describe receipt escrow, not final claim payout. Each receipt requires a separate owner-only claim after its current minimum duration; governance can immediately change the global fee curve for existing receipts.

Official docs contain stale single-request/20-day ERC7540 and legacy UnlockToken descriptions alongside newer NFT unlock documentation. The exact reviewed implementation uses receipt(), not deprecated unlockToken(); no legacy UnlockToken target is admitted. Jurisdiction restrictions still apply; permissionless contract access does not waive legal eligibility.

Claim must be sent by the actual receipt owner, not an approved operator. Receiver must be nonzero; the underlying apxUSD transfer may still revert under its own deny-list. No cancellation or receipt transfer is available in this implementation.

limitations: Static deployment/source inventory only, not a fresh RPC/runtime/storage identity or successful-execution guarantee. Balances, allowances, pauses, canonical calldata, grants and independent execution checks remain mandatory; zero native value for all admitted calls.
